# PixelTools

> Free, private, browser-based image editing tools.

## Tools
- Resize: Resize images to any dimension
- Compress: Reduce image file size
- Crop: Crop images to custom sizes
- Convert: Convert between JPG, PNG, WebP
- Remove BG: Remove image backgrounds
- Watermark: Add watermarks to images
- Image to PDF: Combine images into a PDF document
- PDF to Image: Convert PDF pages to downloadable images

## Notes
- All processing is done client-side
- No images are uploaded to any server
- Free to use, no account required
